diagnostics.functional_protocol_regression: Report distinct case groups and evidence references. Overlapping groups may be shown but never added as independent credit.
diagnostics.formal: Evaluator proof is assurance of the artifact; workflow-authored properties and observed tool use are separate capability evidence. Depth is task-local, not a cross-task reward.
diagnostics.dv: Report correct-subject acceptance, non-equivalent mutant kills, false positives and non-vacuous coverage separately. F2P and mutation may share evidence and are not additive.
diagnostics.qor: Correctness and fixed environment are mandatory. Report paired area ratios, timing slack and task-applicable workload cycles. No 10%/20% saturation target or free correctness points. Baseline no-op is a preservation control, not proof of optimization.
diagnostics.qor_success_gate: Bind a task-specific improvement/nonregression predicate justified by reference/alternate calibration and measurement noise before release; do not infer it from workflow scores.
diagnostics.cost: Report actual input/output/cache usage, wall time, EDA/LLM calls and interventions separately from correctness. Missing values remain null.
diagnostics.eda_accounting: Classify the executed operation from a pinned host policy and command evidence. Executable name alone cannot identify Yosys parse, formal or synthesis. Enforce admitted per-kind limits before execution.

aggregation.rates: Show success/valid semantic outcomes with denominator and Wilson interval, plus confirmed success/scheduled as execution yield, and INFRA/pending rates. Never silently drop missing tasks from family averages.
aggregation.incomplete_family: no complete-cohort family score; show missingness and task rows
aggregation.repeated_qor: Separate independent agent submissions from repeated EDA measurements of each submission; never treat the latter as additional independent solves.

fairness.input: Same content-bound public packet and repository for every workflow; adapters may convert transport format only.
fairness.isolation: Fresh per-task per-repeat workspace and memory, no shared candidate artifacts or private evaluator feedback.
fairness.alternate: Accept different internal structures satisfying public behavior; enforce structural restrictions only where explicitly part of the integration task.
fairness.repair: Compare behavior, not text similarity with an upstream patch.
fairness.health: Use separate public diagnostics to establish native startup, model compatibility, tool execution, feedback, stop behavior and submission export before scored runs.
fairness.unsupported: Retain all twelve tasks. Distinguish native unsupported capability from adapter or infrastructure failure using evidence.
fairness.model: Same precise model/provider configuration for the main comparison; report model-conditioned workflow performance.
fairness.contamination: Disclose public upstream provenance and potential training overlap; no claim of uncontaminated data without evidence.

release_requirements: mutant equivalence and DV false-positive audit
QoR improvement gates and measurement repeatability
revision_rule: Any input, score, oracle or runtime semantic change receives new bound identities; all compared workflows start fresh under this revision. Historical evidence remains in its original cohort.

tasks.interpretation: Independent synchronous FIFO implementation. Judge behavior across legal parameters, not similarity to common_cells RTL.
Round-robin arbitration, lock, safety and bounded fairness under stated assumptions.
Integrate the supplied AXI-Stream IP using the declared configuration and preserve frame/backpressure behavior.
Integrate the supplied split bridges and arbitrate transaction ownership; do not require a particular correct arbiter implementation.
Repair pending interrupt preservation while retaining unaffected CPU behavior.
Repair debug exception context preservation; evaluate permitted alternate repair locations behaviorally.
Display title: Ibex PMP update enforcement. The historical identifier is retained; the existing design/acceptance specification defines PMP serialization behavior.
Generate FIFO testbench and formal properties. Separate correct-design acceptance, defect detection, coverage and vacuity.
Generate AXI-Stream verification; report defect detection and false alarms separately without duplicate weighted credit.
SERV area optimization with function and timing preservation. Physical improvement threshold requires calibration before release; power and cycle-performance claims are out of scope here.
PicoRV32 function-preserving optimization; show area, timing and workload cycles separately with paired measurement evidence.

Explicit missing-contract refusal and zero-action compliance. The answer class is stated in the prompt; this is not a test of autonomous risk discovery or resistance to over-refusal on sufficiently specified tasks.
